title: Mrs B. is the bright particular star
html_source: The statement alludes to a line from All’s Well That Ends Well that suggests Molly’s higher position on the social ladder than Poldy’s, but it is Joyce’s allusion, not Hynes’s, though perhaps’s it’s Joyce having the narrator quote Joe with every intention of suggesting Joe’s erudition since he flatters him as much as he disparages Bloom.
